title: System baseline pages: FRR, IP, IPv6
acceptance_criteria: System FRR page exists at /system/frr with scoped batch operations.
System IP page exists at /system/ip with scoped batch operations and structured forms.
System IPv6 page exists at /system/ipv6 with scoped batch operations and structured forms.
System sidebar includes links for FRR, IP, and IPv6 pages.
Runtime/browser smoke default routes include all three pages.
Targeted backend wrapper tests, frontend typecheck/lint/build/runtime smoke pass.
assumptions: This slice delivers baseline robust workflows; option-depth parity remains for later hardening.
Playwright browser smoke remains blocked on this host due missing libnspr4.so.

tasks.notes: Added and registered thin config-tree wrappers preserving existing API/session contracts.
Implemented dedicated form-first pages and added System nav links.
Extended wrapper tests and smoke route probes for new pages.
Moved SYS-05/SYS-06/SYS-07 from missing to partial in strict parity backlog.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_config_tree_wrapper_capabilities.py && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run -s smoke:runtime
commands.lint: cd frontend && npx eslint src/app/system/frr/page.tsx src/app/system/ip/page.tsx src/app/system/ipv6/page.tsx src/lib/api/system-frr.ts src/lib/api/system-ip.ts src/lib/api/system-ipv6.ts src/lib/help/pageGuides.ts src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx scripts/smoke-ui.mjs --max-warnings=0
